Tap + to add a reminder. Record your voice, choose an audio file, or type a message to be read aloud. Microphone access is only needed to record.

Choose a future date and time. For a repeating reminder, choose how often it repeats. Preview your recording, then tap Save.

Today shows reminders due today. Upcoming shows later dates.
Make sure you can hear it

Allow notifications when asked. In Settings, check alarm timing access and background battery settings so Android can deliver reminders reliably.

For voice alerts, keep automatic playback on and tone-only mode off. Typed messages also need spoken text enabled. Turn up alarm volume; private playback uses a headset or the earpiece.

Quiet Time and lock-screen playback settings can change when you hear speech. You can review these in Settings.

Snooze delays the current alert; a repeating schedule continues afterward. Silence stops sound but leaves the reminder pending.

Done on an alert completes that occurrence and stops its follow-up checks. Repeating reminders continue at their next time.

In Upcoming, marking a repeating occurrence Done skips that future occurrence. It does not pause the whole schedule. A one-time reminder moves to Done, where you can reschedule it.
Try one before you rely on it

Create a reminder two minutes from now. Lock your phone and wait for the notification and voice. Then try Snooze and Done.

If a notification appears without voice, try Play or Replay. Check playback settings, volume, and connected headphones. Missed shows reminders that could not be delivered normally; a late reminder may require you to tap Play.

Use Help on the home screen or App guide in Settings to reopen these steps anytime.

Take a moment to review Settings. You can keep the defaults and change things later.

Start with Playback: choose voice or tone, volume, spoken language, and private playback.

Check snooze duration and quiet hours, then Reliability for follow-up checks and keeping alerts visible until Done. Also review notification, exact-alarm, and battery access.

Explore Appearance and Reminder form to choose your language, theme, and the inputs you want to see. Backup lets you save reminders and recordings.

Use the test reminder in Playback to check your setup.
